meta.name: paper-fetch
meta.description: Use whenever the user wants to obtain, download, or fetch a paper's PDF — given a DOI, an arXiv id, a paper title, a citation, or a list of DOIs. Trigger on phrases like "download this paper", "find the PDF for [DOI]", "grab me the [Nature/bioRxiv/arXiv] paper on X", "get the open-access version", "I need this article", or any bulk/batch paper download request, even when the user doesn't explicitly say "PDF" or "DOI". Resolves via Unpaywall → Semantic Scholar → arXiv → PubMed Central → bioRxiv/medRxiv → publisher direct (institutional opt-in) → Sci-Hub mirrors as last-resort fallback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以根据你提供的论文 DOI、标题或 arXiv ID 自动查找并下载 PDF 文件。它会依次尝试多个开放获取数据库，直到找到可用的 PDF。
howto.when: 当你要求获取某篇论文的 PDF，例如说“下载这篇论文”、“找一下这篇论文的 PDF”或“帮我获取这篇论文”时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically find and download PDFs of papers given a DOI, title, or arXiv ID. It tries multiple open-access sources in priority order until a PDF is found.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to obtain a paper's PDF, e.g., "download this paper", "find the PDF for [DOI]", or "get me this paper".

say_en.note: Claude will fetch the PDF directly using the DOI.

say_en.text: Find the PDF for the paper titled "Attention Is All You Need".
say_en.note: Claude will resolve the title to a DOI first, then download.
Claude will download each DOI's PDF in sequence.
